Mira: Morning rotation — handing off to Derek in ~15. Quick status and asks:
- KV change deployed last night: `kv.expiry_minutes` bumped to 90. Watch for eviction spikes and cache-miss regressions.
- Canary for small-gen-model (v3.2-q4) completed but p95 in eu-west-1 popped ~+120ms vs baseline. Not an incident yet, just FYI.
- Build-agent-7 maintenance at 09:30 UTC (expected ~1h) — CI jobs may queue up.
Action items:
1) Derek — own eu-west p95 + pref-queue for first hour.
2) Sam — double-check autoscaler thresholds for Dedicated Pool C; it tripped twice overnight.
3) Olivia — the embed-index CI flaky test appears noisy, opened ENG-4821.
If pref queue_length > 120, run the pref-eviction script: `curl -s https://infra.int/metrics/queues | jq '.prefetch.queue_length'`
We saw this log overnight:
[2026-03-18T02:14:05Z] evict_worker: pref_evict triggered count=134 reason=kv_eviction_spike
Mira: Ping @Derek when you take over. :wave:

Derek: Taking over now. I'll watch p95, autoscaler logs, and set a temp alert on pref queue at 100 to cut down noise.

Monitoring Bot: Alert rule 'prefetch_queue' muted 1h by Derek for tuning.

Sam: Quick context — autoscaler bump was from an internal loadtest that sent long sequences. I set a temporary cap to 40% to avoid noisy scaling; will revert after 10:00 UTC if stable.

Olivia: For ENG-4821 (embed-index CI) I pushed a retry wrapper and extra logging. Putting flaky test run history in the ticket.

Mira: Two small follow-ups: (a) Sam, drop the autoscaler dashboard link here; (b) Derek, if tail latency >200ms sustained >10min, fail traffic over to v3.1 fallback (canary policy).

Sam: Dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/autoscaler/pools/C

Derek: Copy that. Will trigger fallback policy if sustained.

Deploy Bot: Canary deploy small-gen-model v3.2-q4 -> completed (10 hosts), status: healthy.

Mira: Thanks — I'll be on-call again at 14:00 UTC if anything escalates. Otherwise quick sync at 10:30. :thumbsup:
